messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm off this weekend (family trip). I was primary for the EU night shift Sat 22:00-06:00 UTC and I don't have coverage lined up. Can someone pick up primary or do a split? I can't be on-call from 22:00 UTC onward. :wave:

raj_s: I can take 22:00-02:00 UTC (early chunk). I'll be remote but available for pages. Happy to be primary for that window. :thumbsup:

jess: I can cover 02:00-06:00 UTC. I have a recurring 15m meeting at 03:15 UTC — if something hits during that time, please escalate to the secondary or call the bridge. Otherwise fine to be primary.

tim: I can be secondary starting 03:45-07:00 UTC and overlap with jess. If needed I can take any lingering pages up to 07:00. Quick Q: do we want a 05:50 handoff check if there are any open customer-impacting issues?

alex: Proposed plan: raj primary 22:00-02:00 UTC, jess primary 02:00-06:00 UTC, tim secondary 03:45-07:00 UTC (covers the weird meeting window). Maria — can you update the calendar event with the handoff notes and bridge info? Also reminder for everyone: if it's customer-impacting (>3 customers or degraded embeddings), escalate immediately and open an incident via incident-bot.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-eu-night — TL;DR: pager -> join bridge -> check Console > Observability > Per-route token breakdown -> run fallback route if p50 latency > 500ms. For full checklist: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/eu-night-checklist

maria: Thanks all — I'll put the explicit times into the rota and add a handoff note in the calendar event. Escalation policy reminder: >3 customers or any data loss = declare incident, use `incident-bot create` and notify @eng-sre.

raj_s: Confirmed — I'll be primary at 22:00 UTC. Phone and pager details are on my profile. I'll pre-warm the KV cache 30m before shift with a quick ops call:

```sh
curl -X POST https://redwood.internal/api/ops/warmup -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' -d '{"profile":"kv-cache","model":"gptx-8b"}'
```

jess: I've added a small canary prompt set to the Console evals for the night (quick perf + correctness). If you see repeated 503s, check the cache and run `redis-cli info` on the ops box and look at the `ops:cache:*` keys.

tim: I'll take secondary from 03:45 and monitor the bridge. If the 06:00-07:00 slot is still uncovered, let's do a short handshake at 05:50 UTC so the outgoing primary can pass context. If anything high-severity, call me directly.

maria: Perfect — appreciate the coverage. I'll update the calendar and add the bridge number + the short checklist. Good luck and have a restful weekend everyone :sparkles:
